method: Chronos-2 + Frozen Pool-Aware v2 Expert Memory/Fusion
memory_source: frozen Pool-Aware v2 expert pool (results/reward_feedback_critic_v2_full_cross_dataset/<ds>/final_expert_pool.json) via ConditionalExpertMLPRetriever
lambda_selection: VAL only (seed 42 representative VAL memory pred); TEST evaluated once with frozen lambda
v2_memory_seed_effect: per-seed train_arm + retrieve_conditional (rng=default_rng(seed)); 3 seeds -> 3 memory preds

frozen_v2_reproduction.check: v2_repro_check compares seed42 TEST memory MSE vs frozen final_test_summary.csv v2_mean_mse (tolerance 1e-3)

data_protocol.split: train=idx[train], val=idx[val], test=idx[test]; bank=first 80% train, fit=last 20% train
